parts.label: Topic Preparation
parts.instruction: Think about your answers to the following questions. You will discuss these topics in the next class. Take 30 seconds to prepare each one.
questions: What is the most important factor for you when purchasing a computer. - Processing speed/ -Storage capacity/ -Price
What is the most popular transportation in your country? Bike/Bus/Motorbike
In your opinion, what is the most crucial factor for a company's long-term success? - Strong leadership/ -Quality products/ - Effective marketing strategy

content.question: How often do you buy new shoes? Do you like to buy shoes from the same brand?
What makes you buy a new pair of shoes?

What is the most important thing that you would consider when buying new shoes?
- Comfort
- Durability
- Appearance
